title: The phone test for Download my data expects the Saved line after the share sheet is closed without saving
what: The real-phone backup test taps Save the backup file, presses Back on the share sheet without picking anywhere to save, and then waits for the Saved line. It passes only while the known false Saved line is there.
expected: The test should expect no Saved line when the share sheet is closed, so a fix of the known fault passes and the fault cannot come back.
fix_line: Change the test to close the sheet and expect no Saved line, then fix the Saved line

title: The Drive words test locks in a message that names buttons the card does not have
what: The test for Google Drive sign-in problems checks the message word for word, including the two button names that are not on the card. A correct message would fail the test.
expected: The test should check that the message names only the buttons the card really has.
fix_line: Fix the words and the test together to name the real buttons

title: No test checks the restore screen steps or its undo button
what: Tests prove a restore and an undo put the right data back, but nothing checks the Replace question, the progress lines, the Restored line, or that Undo restore is busy once, disappears after use, is not offered after leaving or from the welcome screen, or that undo after Add or a failed undo behave right.
expected: A screen test drives restore and undo and checks each line the member sees and that undo can run only once.
fix_line: Add a screen test for restore and undo on the Settings page

title: Download my data refusals and the daily file replacement have no test
what: The nothing-to-back-up and sample-member refusals, the old file being replaced by the new day one, and the one-photo-left-out line are never checked by any test.
expected: Tests check each refusal line, that no empty or demo file reaches the share sheet, that old files do not pile up and that one missing photo does not fail the save.
fix_line: Add save tests for an empty phone, the demo data, an older file and a missing photo

title: The packed-again backup message is never tested
what: The ZIP reader test only checks that a compressed entry is refused. No test opens a backup repacked by another app and checks the member gets the packed-again words and nothing changes.
expected: A test opens a repacked backup and checks the exact message and that nothing changed.
fix_line: Add the repacked case to the not-a-backup test

title: Delete my account is tested only on the server, never on the phone
what: The server test proves the account and its copy go. Nothing checks the phone side: the question, the done words, the card going back to Continue with Google, the offline case never saying deleted, and that a fresh account does not bring the old copy back. The erase-and-delete order is checked only by reading source text.
expected: A phone test drives delete with the server answering, refusing and offline, and checks the words and that phone workouts stay.
fix_line: Add a phone test for delete account, including offline

title: Nothing tests that the cloud copy starts by itself
what: Every copy test calls the copy directly. No test checks that a change or an app start sets the copy off within seconds, that it waits for a workout save, that its own writes do not start it again, or that a phone with no account sets no listener.
expected: A test makes a change on a signed-in phone and sees the copy run once by itself, and sees nothing run when signed out.
fix_line: Add a test for the automatic start of the copy

title: The Drive bring-back card guards and words are mostly untested
what: The Drive restore and undo data paths are tested, but the no-backup-in-this-account line, the workout-in-progress refusal (only a source text check that the words exist), the question title, the nothing-to-undo line and the account email line have no test.
expected: Tests check each refusal blocks the restore and each line the card shows.
fix_line: Add tests for the Drive card refusals and words

title: Bring back my workouts has no test of its button, words or refusals
what: The merge logic is well tested, but nothing checks the button for a signed-in member, the brought-back count, the everything-already-here line, or that a workout in progress, demo data or no internet stop it without a success line.
expected: Tests drive the button in each state and check the line shown and that nothing changed when refused.
fix_line: Add tests for the bring-back button states

title: No test checks the account card when signed in or signing out
what: Tests cover the card only when signed out. Nothing checks the Signed in as line, the privacy line, the status line on screen, the sign-out question or the card after signing out, or that a signed-out phone shows no in-a-moment line.
expected: A screen test shows the card signed in, signed out and after sign-out with each line.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the signed-in card and sign out
